methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $2.29B (to $4.93B) × margin 14.9% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $1.49B
K = capital to build it: $2.29B ÷ sales-to-capital 1.50 = $1.52B
σ = 74% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $947.5M
assets in place = NOPAT −$250.0K ÷ WACC = $0; value = ($0 + $947.5M + net cash $1.32B) ÷ 133,252,947 = $17.03
